admission.justification: Binds history identity to (path,id) and the index to v3: no second index owns knowledge rows.

alternatives.option: History rows key on (path,id); the derived index owns exactly 8 logical tables, all read; only the SQLite index is derived and it is owned by the index cache.
alternatives.reason: A second dataset or a path-only key would reintroduce the logical dataset R74 sheds and collide identities across paths.

alternatives.option: Keep a second dataset with path-only history keys.
alternatives.reason: Reintroduces the logical dataset R74 sheds and collides identities across paths.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A second dataset is governed with disjoint identity rules.

consequences: Future knowledge storage keeps the 8-table derived index, the (path,id) history keys and the single index-format pin.
context: MIK-R74 rule 4: the package writes no knowledge dataset; history_row links pick the row filed at the link's own origin path.
